shortDescription.text: Quantum-vulnerable RSA: key wrapping and data encryption at rest (1 file(s))

fullDescription.text: 2 reference(s) to RSA across 1 file(s), e.g. modules/sdk-core/src/bitgo/trading/network/encrypt-rsa-browser.ts:33. Role, judged from paths, function names and nearby code: key wrapping and data encryption at rest. Keys or data encrypted to these public keys are stored: anyone who copies them now decrypts them once a CRQC exists (harvest now, decrypt later). Wrap keys with ML-KEM or a hybrid KEM (X25519 + ML-KEM-768) and re-wrap the stored keys; data that may already have been copied needs its own assessment. This is a forward-looking risk that depends on the arrival of a cryptographically relevant quantum computer (CRQC). No such computer is publicly known to exist today; the timeline is uncertain. It is not a present-day exploitable vulnerability. Heuristic pattern match on source text without data-flow analysis. The usage context (security-relevant or not) must be confirmed manually; treat as preliminary.
